mapper.sql: select id, shop_code, name, image, phone, province, city, district, address, longitude, latitude, open_time, close_time, preorder_min_minutes, preorder_max_days, make_lead_minutes, status, notice, pack_fee, sort_order, del_flag, create_time, update_time from shop
mapper.select:
where del_flag = 0
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by sort_order asc, id desc

where del_flag = 0
and ( name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or concat_ws('', province, city, district, address) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by (longitude is null or latitude is null) asc, ( 6371000 * 2 * asin(sqrt(least(1, pow(sin(radians(latitude - #{latitude}) / 2), 2) + cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(latitude)) * pow(sin(radians(longitude - #{longitude}) / 2), 2) ))) ) asc, sort_order asc, id desc
order by sort_order asc, id desc
limit #{limit}
